show.title: Frankly speaking Podcast
show.author: Frankly speaking
paragraphs: Host Frank Amedia takes the call from the places the news cycle reaches last — and then asks the question the news cycle skips: what is God doing in this.

These episodes are drawn from the Frankly Speaking broadcast archive, cut down to the moments that still hold. Frontline dispatches from Israel and from inside Iran. Testimony from people who paid for it. Bible prophecy read against the morning's headlines. Prayer that names the thing directly.

Recurring voices include Mati Shoshani in Jerusalem, Mani Erfan reporting from inside Iran, Yair Pinto — a Jewish follower of Jesus and a captain in the armored corps of the IDF — CBN's Chris Mitchell, Lt. Gen. Jerry Boykin, Samuel Smadja, Haim Malespin and Juliana Taimoorazy.
Episodes are grouped by theme: the Israel–Iran war, testimonies and miracles, Bible prophecy, Jewish–Christian relations, prayer and the spiritual life, the church, America, and the media.

episodes.title: The Israel–Iran War, Part 1
episodes.summary: Frontline reporting, insider dispatches from inside Iran, and the strategy behind the headlines — the strongest moments on the Israel–Iran war from the Frankly Speaking broadcast archive, with host Frank Amedia.
notes: Frontline reporting, insider dispatches from inside Iran, and the strategy behind the headlines — the strongest moments on the Israel–Iran war from the Frankly Speaking broadcast archive, with host Frank Amedia.

In this episode: the Strait of Hormuz and Frank's coalition plan to hold it; CBN's Chris Mitchell watching an Iron Dome intercept from his balcony; the Cyrus Accords; the race to extract Iran's 460 kg of enriched uranium; the UN's 13–0 vote isolating Iran; a warning out of Tehran about coming retribution; Lt. Gen. Jerry Boykin on how the conflict began; and the missile that fell on a school in Tehran.
Featuring Chris Mitchell, Yair Pinto, Samuel Smadja, Haim Malespin, Lt. Gen. Jerry Boykin, Juliana Taimoorazy and Mati Shoshani.
